AppStats.title: AppStats
AppStats.description: Global statistics for the Islamic library web application including total visits and readers

totalVisits.description: Total number of visits recorded across all readers

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp string of when the stats were last modified

dailyDate.description: Current date in YYYY-MM-DD format for tracking daily unique readers

dailyUniqueVisitors.description: Number of unique readers recorded for the current day (dailyDate)

activeReaders.description: Map of deviceId to last activity epoch timestamp (ms) for tracking online readers active within the last 5 minutes

/app_stats/{statsId}.description: Public aggregated statistics for the library web application
